newsitem.title: GERMANY: Duerr wins 300 mln dmk order from Daimler.
newsitem.headline: Duerr wins 300 mln dmk order from Daimler.

text.p: German plant construction group Duerr AG said on Friday it had won an order worth more than 300 million marks to build a paintworks for Daimler-Benz AG.
Duerr said the plant, to be built in Bremen and completed by the year 2003, is one of the biggest projects it has won from Daimler-Benz so far.
The plant will paint Mercedes-Benz C-class models as well as the SL and SLK sports cars and the CLK coupe, Duerr said in a mandatory statement.
Duerr said the contract was awarded to its subsidiary Duerr Systems GmbH.
